services.name: - Sessions
services.desc: A Discovery Session is a complimentary 25min consultation with one of our Pilates teachers! In this session you can expect to have a tour of the studio, let us know what brings you in, go over your movement history and goals, and learn how Pilates with us can help you start feeling your best! After your Discovery Session, we ask that you continue your Pilates journey with us by taking advantage of our New Client 3-Pack of Private Lessons. This will ensure that you have an understanding of how to use the equipment safely and effectively, so that you get the most out of your future sessions- whether it be group classes or private lessons. services.name: Teacher Training
services.desc: The Pilates Movement (TPM) is a state licensed 550 hour Comprehensive Pilates Teacher Training Program, that is held at Contrology Studio in Louisville, CO, and led by studio owner & Program Director Whitney Shea, PTA, CPT, RYT. The program consists of 84 lecture-style hours, over a course of 5 module training (see schedule below), as well as 466 lab / hands-on learning hours. Pilates Practice (100 hours) : This includes self Pilates practice, as well as classes & lessons with CS teacher, fellow TPM peers, or another approved teacher.
